hosts_send.note: kind is not on the wire: download, the send after a download (34.9.2); delta, an ordinary send point, whose body also carries the day's other counts (not shown). A report id here is r1, r2, ... in seal order; on the wire it is 32 random lower-case hex digits per body. An answer: 202; lost (the server counted it, the SDK got no answer); 503 (not counted, kept); not sent (no network, or the process ended first). A step without answers: 202 for each body sent. In fail and proto a key left out is 0. server_sums, per day and host: what the server counted, entries (counted bodies naming the host) and installs (of them, day_first 1: 34.9.4).

cases.name: a download ends: its host counts are sealed alone and sent at once; the next send point carries what came after
the send fails: the same body and id at the next send point, never added into a later body
the answer is lost: the body is sent again with its id, and the server counts it once
the fifth download end of a day seals nothing; the next send point carries its counts
midnight closes the day's counts; a download after it seals the new day's only, and both are sent, oldest first
a restart between the seal and the send: the body is sent at the launch, and day_first is kept
telemetry off in the signed config: nothing counted, nothing sent, the waiting body dropped
at most 8 hosts a day across all its sends: a ninth is not counted, one of the eight still is
